feeding_claim.verbatim: Our herbivores (cows, sheep) are never fed grain on the EKC farm.

local_areas: Home delivery in certain zip codes

notes: Family farm at Fairmount, Indiana (Grant County), founded by Willis Loftin. Read the homepage, about page, mission, protocols, regenerative agriculture, partners, staff, blog, store, order pickup and contact pages. Protocols page says cows and sheep are never fed grain and grassfed animals eat only pasture and stored grasses; pigs and chickens get non-GMO feed, and some products are marked as supplemented with free-choice grains, which appear to be the omnivore products. Store shows categories Grass-fed Beef, Pastured Poultry, Grass-fed Lamb, Pastured Pork, Pastured Eggs, EKC Honey and Essential Oil Blends, but individual products need a login and were not seen, so availability and bulk shares are unconfirmed. Pickup at the farm gets a 10% discount; a pop-up mentions home delivery in certain zip codes, none named. The blog has no posts and the partners page says content to come, so how active the store is could not be confirmed. The farm also has a Market Wagon vendor page (not used as a source). The verbatim quote came from a WebFetch extraction, not the raw page.
